title: Implement controller-only preview modal
description: Implement the Filter Controller preview modal as a contextual contract preview, not a frontend listing preview.
objective: Close frame 16 and modal behavior without adding runtime filtering.
acceptance_criteria: The modal opens from current in-memory form state without saving.
The modal remains contextual to the selected preset/state.
Keyboard close and escape behavior are safe enough for WP admin.
verification: Confirm preview does not save data.
Implemented focus target, return-focus, Escape close, backdrop close, and Tab containment for the controller-only modal.
Added modal viewport containment so mobile uses internal dialog scrolling instead of page-level overflow.
WP-CLI render smoke returned preview-modal:ok for architecture-preview.

Playwright evidence recorded under docs/assets/implementation-toolkit/admin-v0.2/qa/TASK-007 with desktop and mobile screenshots, open/no-save check, keyboard/focus check, mobile overflow check, and console error log.

QA confirmed No listing grid marker, 0 frontend grid selectors, 0 new resources on modal open, 0 browser console errors, no page-level horizontal overflow, and no runtime filtering or save path introduced.
risks: Preview may accidentally imply runtime filtering exists.
Modal focus behavior may conflict with WordPress admin chrome.
